content: RubyGems recommends Trusted Publishing with OIDC short-lived gem-scoped tokens, MFA, least-privilege API keys, and expirations. GitHub supports dependency review, immutable releases, and build provenance attestations, while warning that attestations must be verified and do not prove security. Release gates should build once from a protected tag, verify contents and checksums, attest provenance, and publish through a protected release environment.
